episodeTitle.en: The art of building legendary brands | Arielle Jackson (Google, Square, First Round Capital)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造传奇品牌的艺术》 | 阿里尔·杰克逊（Arielle Jackson，曾就职于Google、Square、First Round Capital）

guestBioOfficial.en: What makes a great brand? After working at Google and Square, Arielle Jackson has spent the past eight years consulting startups on how to create powerful messaging that works. In this jam-packed episode, she shares how to pick a winning name for your company, create a brand purpose that excites your team and customers, and position your company and its products for success. You don’t want to miss this one!
guestBioOfficial.zh: 什么造就了一个伟大的品牌？在谷歌和Square工作后，阿里尔·杰克逊过去八年一直为初创公司提供如何创建强有力的信息传递策略的咨询服务。在这期内容丰富的节目中，她将分享如何为你的公司选一个获胜的名字，创建一个能激发团队和客户热情的品牌宗旨，以及为你的公司及其产品定位成功的方向。你一定不想错过这一期！

title.en: The art of building legendary brands | Arielle Jackson (Google, Square, First Round Capital)
title.zh: 《打造传奇品牌的艺术》 | 阿里尔·杰克逊（Arielle Jackson，曾就职于Google、Square、First Round Capital）

summary.en: Arielle covers three core topics: naming strategies for your startup or product, a framework for developing your brand (purpose, positioning, personality), and how to get PR. She argues a bad name won't kill a great company but a good name helps, and that brand is the overall marketing and strategy, not just the name. The conversation is a practical guide for early founders shaping how the world sees them.
summary.zh: Arielle 涵盖了三个核心主题：为创业公司或产品命名策略、打造品牌的框架（使命、定位、个性），以及如何做公关。她认为坏名字不会毁掉好公司，但好名字有帮助，且品牌是整体的营销与战略，而非仅仅名字。对话为早期创始人塑造自身形象提供了实用指南。
